boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Boston College
boards.description: A guide to the essential late-night food rituals and study spots that define the after-hours experience for Boston College students.

cards.title: Late Night at The Rat
cards.subtitle: Lyons Hall Basement
cards.notes: Visit the basement of Lyons Hall for student favorites like mozzarella sticks and chicken tenders, served Sunday through Thursday until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A central campus hub for late-night snacks and socializing in the basement of Lyons Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Lyons is open for Late Night dining Sunday-Thursday from 7 p.m.–12 a.m. featuring mozzarella sticks and chicken tenders.
cards.source_title: Lyons Hall - Dining Services - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday-Thursday until 12:00 AM for late-night service.

cards.title: The 24/5 Study Grind
cards.subtitle: Main Research Library
cards.notes: Utilize the 24/5 access during the semester to power through late-night research or group projects in a variety of study environments.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering 24-hour access five days a week during the academic semester.
cards.evidence_claim: O'Neill Library is open 24/5 during Fall and Spring semesters, opening at 9am Sundays and remaining open through Friday at 10pm.
cards.source_title: Q. What time does the library open and close? - Boston College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours from Sunday morning through Friday night during the semester.

cards.title: Cleveland Circle Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: 1920 Beacon St
cards.notes: Grab a slice at this local staple in Cleveland Circle, which stays open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing pizza shop in Cleveland Circle popular for late-night slices and takeout.
cards.evidence_claim: Pino's Pizza is open Friday & Saturday from 10AM-1AM and Sunday-Thursday until 11PM.
cards.source_title: Pinos Pizza - Best Italian Cuisine in Brighton
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Post-Study Ice Cream
cards.subtitle: 19 Commonwealth Ave
cards.notes: Visit this spot across from campus for small-batch ice cream, continuing the tradition of the former White Mountain Creamery.
cards.short_summary: A modern ice cream shop located directly across from campus, serving handcrafted flavors late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: New City Microcreamery opened in the former White Mountain Creamery space and is noted for being open late every day.
cards.source_title: New City Microcreamery Opens in Chestnut Hill
cards.access_notes: Open late daily; typically until 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM depending on the day.

cards.title: Newton Campus Late Night
cards.subtitle: Newton Campus
cards.notes: Newton Campus residents head to Stuart for late-night pizza, chicken sandwiches, and pastries during the academic week.
cards.short_summary: The primary late-night dining destination for students living on the Newton Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Stuart is often the location of a late-night visit for those on Newton, offering pizza, chicken sandwiches, and pastries.
cards.source_title: Midnight Munchies: The Quest for Late-Night Eats at BC - The Gavel
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours typically align with other major campus dining halls (until 11:00 PM or 12:00 AM).

cards.title: The El Guapo Run
cards.subtitle: 2197 Commonwealth Ave
cards.notes: Walk over to this Brighton favorite for authentic tacos and burritos, serving the BC community until 9:00 PM or 11:00 PM depending on the season.
cards.short_summary: A highly-regarded Mexican eatery located just a short walk from the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: El Pelón Taquería serves authentic Mexican food and is open 7 days a week until 11PM at some locations, with the Brighton location listed at 9PM.
cards.source_title: Locations — El Pelón Taquería
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 9:00 PM (Brighton location).

cards.title: BC After Dark
cards.subtitle: Lower Campus
cards.notes: Experience the seasonal 'BC After Dark' program at Hillside Cafe, offering burgers and fries until midnight on select nights.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal late-night dining initiative transforming Hillside Cafe into a social restaurant space.
cards.evidence_claim: BC After Dark operates at Hillside Cafe on Thursdays from 5 p.m. to midnight, and on Fridays and Saturdays from 4:30 p.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: "BC After Dark" debuts - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Seasonal program; open until 12:00 AM Thursday-Saturday when active.

cards.title: Upper Campus Late Night
cards.subtitle: Carney Dining Room
cards.notes: Upper Campus residents often gather at McElroy for late-night dining options like chicken tenders and fries during the week.
cards.short_summary: The primary late-night dining hall for freshmen and other residents on Upper Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Late night dining is offered at all three primary dining halls including McElroy Commons.
cards.source_title: Boston College to Resume Late Night Dining on Tuesday - BC Heights
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours typically run until 11:00 PM or 12:00 AM on school nights.

cards.title: Addie's Dinner Run
cards.subtitle: Corcoran Commons
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of Corcoran Commons for inventive dinner options and late-afternoon snacks before the late-night rush.
cards.short_summary: A popular dining spot in Corcoran Commons known for its sustainable and creative menu items.
cards.evidence_claim: Addie's in Corcoran Commons serves dinner from 4:30 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. and grab-and-go snacks until 4:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: What's Open? - Dining Services - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Dinner service ends at 7:00 PM, serving as an early evening alternative.

cards.title: Stokes Hall Study Fuel
cards.subtitle: Stokes Hall South
cards.notes: Fuel your late-afternoon study sessions with chocolate-covered treats and Starbucks coffee in the heart of the humanities building.
cards.short_summary: A specialty cafe in Stokes Hall offering sweets and coffee to students studying in the academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chocolate Bar in Stokes Hall offers chocolate muffins, chocolate-covered Oreos, and Starbucks Coffee.
cards.source_title: Chocolate Bar - Dining Services - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 5:00 PM or 8:00 PM depending on the semester schedule.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student spaces across Boston College's campuses, from quiet library nooks and modern science hubs to wellness lounges and historic student unions.

cards.title: The Former Server Room Study Space
cards.subtitle: O'Neill Library
cards.notes: Visit the renovated 5th-floor space, once a server room, now featuring high tables and cushioned chairs for quiet individual work.
cards.short_summary: A modern, quiet study area on the top floor of the main research library.
cards.evidence_claim: The 5th floor of O'Neill Library features a remodeled study space, originally a server room, intended to accommodate students with high and low tables and cushioned chairs.
cards.source_title: New Fifth Floor O'Neill Study Space - Boston College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; Level 5 is designated for quiet and individual study.

cards.title: The Bapst Basement Carrels
cards.subtitle: Bapst Library
cards.notes: Head to the basement level for a less crowded alternative to Gargan Hall, offering individual carrels with reliable power outlets.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative and quieter alternative to the famous Hogwarts-style reading room upstairs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bapst Library basement (Art Stacks) is a collaborative study space that is often less crowded than the upper floors and provides working outlets at each desk.
cards.source_title: Back to School Guide: Top Study Spots on Campus - BC Heights
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library hours; designated as a collaborative study space.

cards.title: The Schiller Institute Hub
cards.subtitle: 245 Beacon Street
cards.notes: Utilize the open collaboration areas and public seating in this modern STEM facility, which features floor-to-ceiling glass and natural light.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech, light-filled space for interdisciplinary collaboration and study.
cards.evidence_claim: 245 Beacon Street features public collaboration areas, maker spaces, and gathering areas designed to promote creativity and innovation across disciplines.
cards.source_title: Scientific Exploration - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; includes the Tully Cafe on the first floor for indoor and outdoor seating.

cards.title: The Gasson Hall Wellnest
cards.subtitle: Gasson Hall
cards.notes: Relax in the 'Health Hub' outside Gasson 013, featuring couches and lap desks for a tranquil break between classes.
cards.short_summary: A wellness-focused lounge area located in the basement of BC's most iconic building.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Health Hub' located outside of Gasson 013 features couches, lap desks, and wellness resources for students to enjoy a tranquil study space.
cards.source_title: About CSW - Center for Student Wellness - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours, typically Monday-Friday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. for full services.

cards.title: The Humanities Garden Tables
cards.subtitle: Stokes Hall
cards.notes: Find a seat at the outdoor tables in the Stokes garden or the second-story hallway chairs for views of the campus green.
cards.short_summary: Quiet outdoor and indoor seating areas within the humanities building complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Stokes Hall creates a popular new outdoor garden and plaza with informal social spaces that promote learning outside the classroom.
cards.source_title: Boston College, Stokes Hall - Tsoi Kobus Design
cards.access_notes: Outdoor spaces are accessible 24/7; indoor hallway seating is available during building hours.

cards.title: The Upper Campus Student Union
cards.subtitle: Upper Campus
cards.notes: Escape to the solarium for a relaxed atmosphere with comfy leather couches, located in a historic mansion on Upper Campus.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, residential-style student union perfect for freshmen living on Upper Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: O'Connell House offers a solarium for a relaxed atmosphere and comfy leather couches for students to sit back and study.
cards.source_title: O'Connell House Student Union - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 8 a.m. to 11 p.m. for student use.

cards.title: The Maloney Hall Quiet Lounge
cards.subtitle: Maloney Hall
cards.notes: Head to the 4th-floor reception area for new furniture and additional seating in a quiet, professional environment.
cards.short_summary: A lesser-known quiet lounge area on the upper floors of Maloney Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4th Floor Maloney Hall Reception Area is open Monday–Thursday 9:00 a.m. – 11:00 p.m. with new furniture for additional seating.
cards.source_title: Find a space - Students - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday until 11 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: The McGuinn Hall Basement Nook
cards.subtitle: McGuinn Hall
cards.notes: Use the individual study carrels and group study rooms in this quiet basement library, often overlooked by undergraduates.
cards.short_summary: A focused, quiet library space located on the lower ground floor of McGuinn Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Social Work Library in McGuinn Hall B38 offers study carrels, computer pods, and group study spaces with smart televisions.
cards.source_title: Library - School of Social Work - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open to all BC students; check library website for current daily hours.

cards.title: The Brighton Campus Retreat
cards.subtitle: Brighton Campus
cards.notes: Take the shuttle to Brighton Campus for a peaceful study session in the TML atrium, featuring brutalist architecture and large windows.
cards.short_summary: A serene and spacious library atrium away from the main campus bustle.
cards.evidence_claim: The Theology and Ministry Library (TML) on Brighton Campus offers collaborative study spaces and an atrium on the lower level for work and reflection.
cards.source_title: Theology and Ministry Library - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the BC shuttle; check library hours for weekend availability.

cards.title: The O'Neill Second Floor Hub
cards.subtitle: O'Neill Library
cards.notes: Access free peer tutoring or find a spot in the inclusive lounge area on the second floor of the main library.
cards.short_summary: An academic support hub with dedicated space for tutoring and skills workshops.
cards.evidence_claim: The Connors Family Learning Center is located on the second floor of O'Neill Library and provides free tutoring and academic coaching to all BC students.
cards.source_title: About - Connors Family Learning Center - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Tutoring hours are typically Monday-Thursday 10 a.m. to 9 p.m. and Sunday 12 p.m. to 8 p.m.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social activities and public spaces at Boston College, from historic reading rooms to scenic reservoir walks and campus traditions.

cards.title: Browse the McMullen Galleries
cards.subtitle: Brighton Campus
cards.notes: Visit this world-class art museum on the Brighton Campus. Admission is always free for students and the general public to view rotating exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A university art museum offering free public admission to its permanent collection and rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the McMullen Museum is always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit – McMullen Museum of Art - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 10am-5pm, Saturday-Sunday 12pm-5pm during the academic year.

cards.title: Study in Gargan Hall
cards.subtitle: Bapst Library
cards.notes: Experience the 'Harry Potter' vibes of this silent study hall. It features stained glass and vaulted ceilings, providing a majestic free workspace.
cards.short_summary: A historic, neo-Gothic silent study hall located on the top floor of Bapst Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Bapst Library offers 400 quiet study spaces... Gargan Hall (top floor of Bapst) has great architecture.
cards.source_title: Boston College Libraries Hours
cards.access_notes: Public access typically allowed during daytime hours; BC ID required after 10pm.

cards.title: Walk the Reservoir Loop
cards.subtitle: Chestnut Hill Reservation
cards.notes: Jog or walk the 1.5-mile paved perimeter trail. It offers iconic views of the Gasson Hall tower and the Boston skyline at no cost.
cards.short_summary: A popular 1.5-mile public walking and running loop adjacent to the Boston College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Enjoy a walk, jog, or bike ride on the 1.5 mile paved trail around the Chestnut Hill Reservoir.
cards.source_title: Chestnut Hill Reservation - Mass.gov
cards.access_notes: Public park open from dawn to dusk daily.

cards.title: Join the Convocation Flight
cards.subtitle: Middle Campus
cards.notes: Participate in the 'First Flight' tradition. Freshmen carry lanterns down these stairs to Conte Forum to mark the start of their journey.
cards.short_summary: A university tradition where freshmen process down the Higgins stairs during Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshman Eagles begin their BC journey with the traditional 'first flight'—a lantern-led procession down the Higgins stairs.
cards.source_title: Boston College Traditions
cards.access_notes: Outdoor stairs accessible 24/7; tradition occurs annually in the fall.

cards.title: Lounge at Stokes Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Stokes Hall
cards.notes: Relax on the tiered grass seating in front of Stokes Hall. It is a prime spot for outdoor socializing and sunbathing between classes.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor tiered lawn and gathering space located in the center of the academic quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Stokes Amphitheater. The lawn in front of Stokes... a perfect location for studying.
cards.source_title: Stokes Amphitheater - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space accessible to the public 24/7.

cards.title: Attend a Public Lecture
cards.subtitle: Devlin Hall
cards.notes: Catch a free guest lecture or film screening in this large auditorium. Many academic events here are open to the entire BC community.
cards.short_summary: A major campus lecture hall that hosts free public academic and cultural events.
cards.evidence_claim: Devlin Hall, 110. New Lecture. Free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Devlin Hall - Boston College Events
cards.access_notes: Event times vary; check the university calendar for free public listings.

cards.title: See the Skyline from O'Neill
cards.subtitle: O'Neill Library
cards.notes: Head to the top floor of the main library for some of the best free views of the Boston skyline and the campus quads.
cards.short_summary: The highest floor of the main campus library, known for its panoramic views and quiet study area.
cards.evidence_claim: 5th floor of O'Neill has great views of the city.
cards.source_title: Any college libraries open to the public - Reddit
cards.access_notes: Open 7am-11pm for the public; BC ID required for late-night access.

cards.title: Relax on St. Mary's Lawn
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Quad
cards.notes: Find a quiet bench on this manicured lawn. It is a peaceful 'oasis' perfect for reading while listening to the Gasson Hall bells.
cards.short_summary: A serene green space located between St. Mary's Hall and O'Neill Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: The lawn outside of St. Mary's Hall is perhaps my favorite lawn on campus... an oasis of serenity.
cards.source_title: The Best of Boston College's Outdoor Spaces - BC Heights
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor lawn area.

cards.title: Take a Free Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Full-time undergrads can join group fitness classes like yoga or HIIT for free. Just sign the waiver in the Agora Portal first.
cards.short_summary: The university's main fitness facility offering free group classes to undergraduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation offers group fitness classes to all members free of charge... All full-time BC undergraduate students are eligible.
cards.source_title: BC Campus Recreation - Fitness
cards.access_notes: Requires BC ID and signed membership agreement for student access.

cards.title: Explore the Arts Festival
cards.subtitle: O'Neill Plaza
cards.notes: Enjoy three days of free music, dance, and theater performances every April. Most events are held in tents on the O'Neill Plaza.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring festival showcasing student and faculty creative works through free public performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boston College Arts Festival... features music, dance, theater, visual arts, and more. It's a great opportunity to enjoy some incredible performances.
cards.source_title: End the Semester With These Fun (and Free) Events - BC Heights
cards.access_notes: Annual event in late April; most performances are free and open to the public.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: Gargan Hall
cards.subtitle: Bapst Library
cards.notes: Study in a silent, cathedral-like hall featuring stained glass and high ceilings. Located on the second floor of Bapst Library, it is designated for quiet individual work.
cards.short_summary: A silent, Gothic-style reading room in Bapst Library known for its historic architecture and quiet study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Gargan Hall is located on the second floor of Bapst Library and is designated as a quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | BC Library Test
cards.access_notes: Open to BC students and faculty; hours vary by semester. Quiet zone rules strictly enforced.

cards.title: O'Neill Library Level 1
cards.subtitle: Main Campus
cards.notes: Utilize collaborative tables and soft seating near vending machines. This floor allows for group discussion and is conveniently located near the Hillside Cafe entrance.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study floor in the main library featuring group seating and proximity to dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: O'Neill Library Level 1 is a collaborative study space that is open 24/7 during certain periods of the academic year.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | BC Library Test
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 during finals; standard hours apply during the semester. No reservation required for open seating.

cards.title: TML Atrium
cards.subtitle: Brighton Campus
cards.notes: Find a seat in this Brutalist-style atrium featuring large windows and natural light. It offers a mix of individual carrels and larger tables for quiet work.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful study area on the Brighton Campus known for its unique architecture and quiet atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Theology and Ministry Library (TML) offers collaborative and individual study spaces, including an atrium on the lower level.
cards.source_title: Theology and Ministry Library - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open to all BC students; located on the Brighton Campus accessible via the BC shuttle.

cards.title: Stokes Hall Commons
cards.subtitle: Middle Campus
cards.notes: Study in the first-floor lounge area with comfortable armchairs. This space is ideal for casual reading and is steps away from The Chocolate Bar cafe.
cards.short_summary: A popular social and study lounge in Stokes Hall with easy access to coffee and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Stokes Hall features a first-floor lounge and hallway seating that are used by students for studying.
cards.source_title: Find a space - Students - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during building hours, typically until 11:00 PM on weekdays.

cards.title: Higgins Atrium
cards.subtitle: Science District
cards.notes: Use the tables in this bright, multi-story atrium located in the biology and physics building. It provides a modern environment for science students between labs.
cards.short_summary: A sunlit, modern atrium in Higgins Hall offering table seating for individual or group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Higgins Atrium is identified as a favorite study spot on campus in student-facing resources.
cards.source_title: The Answer Wall - Boston College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours. Best for daytime study between classes.

cards.title: Student Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Maloney Hall
cards.notes: Access quiet and collaborative areas on the second floor of Maloney Hall. This space is connected to the nursing labs and features modern furniture for long sessions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated learning space in Maloney Hall with areas for both quiet and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Learning Commons on Maloney Hall's second floor provides quiet and collaborative study areas.
cards.source_title: Our Spaces - Connell School of Nursing - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Primarily serves nursing students but open to the BC community during building hours.

cards.title: 245 Beacon Commons
cards.subtitle: Schiller Institute
cards.notes: Find a spot in the public collaboration areas of BC's newest science building. The space features floor-to-ceiling glass and integrated technology for group projects.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art facility with transparent, light-filled common areas for interdisciplinary study.
cards.evidence_claim: 245 Beacon Street includes public collaboration areas and common areas for student use.
cards.source_title: Scientific Exploration - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic hours; some upper-floor tables may be reserved for graduate students.

cards.title: Social Work Library
cards.subtitle: McGuinn Hall
cards.notes: Head to the lower ground floor of McGuinn Hall for a quiet, focused environment. It offers study carrels, computer pods, and small group study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, specialized library in McGuinn Hall ideal for students seeking a distraction-free zone.
cards.evidence_claim: The Social Work Library in McGuinn Hall offers quiet study carrels and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | BC Library Test
cards.access_notes: Open to all BC students; check library website for specific daily hours.

cards.title: Health Hub
cards.subtitle: Gasson Hall
cards.notes: Relax on couches with lap desks in this tranquil space outside Gasson 013. It is designed as a wellness-focused study area with low noise levels.
cards.short_summary: A wellness-oriented study lounge in the iconic Gasson Hall featuring comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Hub in Gasson 013 features couches and lap desks for a tranquil study space.
cards.source_title: Find a space - Students - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement level; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Level 3 Reading Room
cards.subtitle: O'Neill Library
cards.notes: Work at long tables in this collaborative reading room. It is a central hub for students who prefer a moderate level of background activity while studying.
cards.short_summary: A large, collaborative reading room on the main entry level of O'Neill Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Neill Library Floor 3 Reading Room is a collaborative study space available on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | BC Library Test
cards.access_notes: Main entry level; no scan-in required during standard daytime hours.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the essential corridors and micro-districts surrounding Boston College, from the bustling transit hubs of Brighton to the scenic reservoir paths of Chestnut Hill.

cards.title: The Hub of Three T Lines
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street and Chestnut Hill Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this major transit and dining hub where the B, C, and D Green Lines converge, offering easy access to the city and local staples like Eagle's Deli.
cards.short_summary: A central transit and social hub for BC students located at the intersection of Beacon Street and Chestnut Hill Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Cleveland Circle is a major hangout for BC students, featuring popular eateries like Eagle's Deli and access to three MBTA Green Line branches.
cards.source_title: Student Life & Support - Lynch School of Education and Human Development
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the BC Shuttle or a short walk from the Reservoir T stop.

cards.title: The 1.5-Mile Loop
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk or jog the scenic 1.5-mile perimeter path of this historic reservoir, a favorite off-campus recreation spot for the BC community.
cards.short_summary: A historic reservoir with a popular perimeter walking path located directly adjacent to the BC campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chestnut Hill Reservoir is a key off-campus recreation area for students, featuring a perimeter path used for walking and jogging.
cards.source_title: Chestnut Hill Reservoir - Facilities - Boston College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open daily for public use; located across from the main campus entrance.

cards.title: Community Service Core
cards.subtitle: Washington Street Corridor
cards.notes: Engage with the local community at the BC Neighborhood Center, located in the heart of this historic commercial district.
cards.short_summary: A historic neighborhood center on Washington Street that serves as the primary link between BC and the Brighton community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boston College Neighborhood Center is located at 480 Washington Street in the heart of Brighton Center, facilitating student volunteer partnerships.
cards.source_title: About - Boston College Neighborhood Center
cards.access_notes: The BC Neighborhood Center is open for student volunteers and community members.

cards.title: Art and Administration
cards.subtitle: Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the McMullen Museum of Art or administrative offices along this stretch of Comm Ave that connects the main and Brighton campuses.
cards.short_summary: The section of Commonwealth Avenue housing BC's Brighton Campus, including the McMullen Museum of Art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brighton Campus, located across Commonwealth Avenue from the main campus, houses the McMullen Museum of Art and various administrative offices.
cards.source_title: Campuses, Maps & Directions - About BC - Boston College
cards.access_notes: The McMullen Museum is free and open to the public; accessible via the BC Shuttle.

cards.title: The Human Resources Hub
cards.subtitle: Lake Street and Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Find the Department of Human Resources and other university services in the repurposed historic buildings along this quiet residential street.
cards.short_summary: A street on the Brighton Campus containing key university administrative buildings like 129 Lake Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Department of Human Resources is located at 129 Lake Street on the Brighton Campus.
cards.source_title: Directions - Human Resources - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Visitor parking is available in front of the building at 129 Lake Street.

cards.title: Open-Air Retail District
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street (Route 9)
cards.notes: Walk through this upscale open-air shopping area featuring a variety of retail shops, a cinema, and student-friendly study spots like Blue Bottle Coffee.
cards.short_summary: A walkable open-air shopping and dining district located a short distance from campus in Chestnut Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Street is an open-air shopping district in Chestnut Hill that serves as a local retail and dining destination.
cards.source_title: The Street Chestnut Hill | Open-Air Shopping District in Chestnut Hill, MA
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible walkways; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: Off-Campus Living Corridor
cards.subtitle: Chiswick Road and Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Navigate this residential corridor known for its high density of off-campus student housing and its own dedicated Green Line B branch stop.
cards.short_summary: A residential street in Brighton popular for off-campus student housing with a dedicated MBTA stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Chiswick Road is a light rail station on the MBTA Green Line B branch and is a primary location for off-campus student housing.
cards.source_title: Chiswick Road station - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: The T station is located in the median of Commonwealth Avenue at Chiswick Road.

cards.title: The Reservoir Edge
cards.subtitle: South Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this quiet residential street that borders the reservoir and provides a direct pedestrian link between Cleveland Circle and the BC campus.
cards.short_summary: A residential corridor bordering the Chestnut Hill Reservoir that connects Cleveland Circle to the university.
cards.evidence_claim: South Street is a residential area located just outside Cleveland Circle, offering apartments within walking distance to the BC campus.
cards.source_title: 31-35 South Street Apartments | Boston College | Off-Campus Housing Search
cards.access_notes: Public residential street with sidewalk access to the reservoir path.

cards.title: Historic Commercial Link
cards.subtitle: Market Street and Washington Street
cards.notes: Explore the historic commercial roots of Brighton along this street, which once served as a major cattle market and now hosts local businesses.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial street in Brighton that connects Brighton Center to the Charles River.
cards.evidence_claim: Market Street is a historic thoroughfare in Brighton, dating back to the 1650s and formerly known for its weekly cattle market.
cards.source_title: Market Street, Brighton MA - BAHS Home
cards.access_notes: Public street with various retail and dining establishments.

cards.title: Ice Cream and Tacos
cards.subtitle: Commonwealth Avenue at Lake Street
cards.notes: Visit the immediate off-campus block featuring student favorites like White Mountain Creamery and El Pelon Taqueria, right across from the main gate.
cards.short_summary: The commercial block directly across from BC's main entrance on Commonwealth Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: White Mountain Creamery and El Pelon Taqueria are popular student hangouts located directly across the street from the BC campus.
cards.source_title: Area around BC - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Located at the intersection of Commonwealth Avenue and Lake Street.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From the lantern-led 'First Flight' to the high-stakes ALC Showdown, explore the unique rituals and historic traditions that define the Boston College experience.

cards.title: Cheering at Mile 21
cards.subtitle: Patriot's Day at the Heights
cards.notes: Join thousands of students lining Commonwealth Avenue to cheer on Boston Marathon runners as they tackle the grueling Heartbreak Hill near Mile 21.
cards.short_summary: An annual Patriot's Day tradition where the BC community gathers along Mile 21 of the Boston Marathon to support runners.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston College hosts its annual Mile 21 concert, breakfast, and cheer section as runners make their way to the finish line.
cards.source_title: Traditions - Office of Student Involvement - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Public event held annually on the third Monday of April along Commonwealth Avenue.

cards.title: Honoring the Man in the Red Bandanna
cards.subtitle: A Tribute to Welles Crowther '99
cards.notes: Wear a red bandanna to this dedicated football game to honor alumnus Welles Crowther, who saved lives during the September 11 attacks.
cards.short_summary: An annual football game where the BC community wears red bandannas to honor the heroism of alumnus Welles Crowther.
cards.evidence_claim: The first-ever Red Bandanna Game took place Sept. 10, 2011, and has become an annual tradition to celebrate the life of Welles Crowther.
cards.source_title: Welles Crowther - Boston College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Held annually at Alumni Stadium; check the athletic schedule for the specific designated game date.

cards.title: The First Flight Procession
cards.subtitle: Freshman Academic Convocation
cards.notes: Carry a lantern in a silent procession from Linden Lane through Gasson Hall to mark the start of your four-year academic journey.
cards.short_summary: A ritual procession for first-year students that symbolizes the beginning of their academic journey at Boston College.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshman Eagles begin their BC journey with the traditional 'first flight'—a lantern-led procession down the Higgins stairs to the Conte Forum.
cards.source_title: About BC - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually in September for the incoming freshman class.

cards.title: The ALC Showdown
cards.subtitle: Campus-Wide Dance Competition
cards.notes: Watch BC's diverse dance teams compete in Conte Forum during this high-energy annual showcase of talent and cultural awareness.
cards.short_summary: Boston College's largest annual student dance competition, featuring 17 teams competing for charity.
cards.evidence_claim: ALC Showdown brings Boston College's 17 dance teams to Conte Forum for an electric competition and cultural showcase.
cards.source_title: Traditions - Office of Student Involvement - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring at Conte Forum; tickets are required and often sell out.

cards.title: The Bells of Gasson Tower
cards.subtitle: Ignatius, Xavier, Gonzaga, and Berchmans
cards.notes: Listen for the four brass bells that ring every quarter hour, a tradition dating back to 1913 that defines the campus soundscape.
cards.short_summary: The historic bells of Gasson Hall that have announced the time to the Heights for over a century.
cards.evidence_claim: From 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., the bells would announce each quarter of the hour, and every 60 minutes they would toll the exact hour.
cards.source_title: When does Gasson ring? – The Answer Wall
cards.access_notes: The bells ring automatically throughout the day and can be heard across the Main Campus.

cards.title: Modstock Music Festival
cards.subtitle: End-of-Year Concert
cards.notes: Celebrate the last day of classes with a massive outdoor concert in the Mod Lot, a tradition featuring major musical acts.
cards.short_summary: An annual outdoor concert held in the Mod parking lot to celebrate the conclusion of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Modstock turns the Mod lot into a vibrant concert venue, celebrating the close of the academic year in unforgettable style.
cards.source_title: Traditions - Office of Student Involvement - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Held on the final day of spring classes in the Mod Lot on Lower Campus.

cards.title: Rubbing St. Michael's Toe
cards.subtitle: Academic Good Luck Ritual
cards.notes: Visit the statue of St. Michael in Gasson Hall and rub his toe for good luck before your next big exam.
cards.short_summary: A campus superstition where students rub the toe of the St. Michael statue for academic success.
cards.evidence_claim: Rubbing the toe of St. Michael in Gasson Hall is supposed to bring academic good luck.
cards.source_title: Tell me about any BC traditions that most ppl don't know! - The Answer Wall
cards.access_notes: Located inside Gasson Hall; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: The Beanpot Tournament
cards.subtitle: Boston's College Hockey Rivalry
cards.notes: Join the Superfans at TD Garden to cheer on the Eagles in this historic four-team tournament for city bragging rights.
cards.short_summary: A legendary annual hockey tournament between BC, BU, Harvard, and Northeastern held every February.
cards.evidence_claim: Since 1952, teams from BC, BU, Harvard, and Northeastern have competed for hockey dominance in this legendary tournament.
cards.source_title: About BC - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Held the first two Mondays of February at TD Garden in Boston.

cards.title: The Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: A Holiday Arrival by BCPD
cards.notes: Gather on the Plaza for carols, hot chocolate, and the arrival of Santa via a BC Police escort to light the campus tree.
cards.short_summary: An annual holiday celebration featuring student performances and the official lighting of the campus Christmas tree.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Claus makes his annual visit... by special BC Police Department escort. He will celebrate the Christmas tree lighting with BC revelers.
cards.source_title: Traditions - Office of Student Involvement - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December on the O'Neill Plaza.

cards.title: Mudstock Volleyball
cards.subtitle: The Muddy End-of-Year Ritual
cards.notes: Compete in or watch the mud volleyball tournament held in the Mod Lot, a messy and high-energy close to the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A student volleyball tournament played in mud pits constructed in the Mod parking lot.
cards.evidence_claim: Mudstock transforms part of the Mod parking lot into mud volleyball courts where students compete for the Mudstock championship.
cards.source_title: Traditions - Office of Student Involvement - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Takes place on the final day of spring classes in the Mod Lot.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Boston College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Walk the Higgins Stairs
cards.subtitle: A Symbolic First Flight
cards.notes: Join the traditional lantern-led procession down these stairs during Convocation to mark the official start of your freshman year journey.
cards.short_summary: The site of the traditional freshman lantern-led procession during Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: Freshman Eagles begin their BC journey with the traditional “first flight”—a lantern-led procession down the Higgins stairs.
cards.source_title: About BC - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a primary campus thoroughfare; Convocation event is scheduled annually.

cards.title: Breakfast at Carney's
cards.subtitle: Upper Campus Dining
cards.notes: Head to the third floor of 'Mac' for a weekend brunch. It is the primary dining hub for freshmen living on Upper Campus.
cards.short_summary: A central dining facility on Upper Campus serving three meals daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Carney's, on the third floor of Mac, is open for three meals a day, seven days a week.
cards.source_title: A Guide to Making the Most of Your Meal Plan - BC Heights
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check the BC Dining website for specific weekend brunch hours.

cards.title: Find a Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Main Research Hub
cards.notes: Scope out your favorite floor in the main library. The first floor often remains open late for students needing a quiet space.
cards.short_summary: The primary research library at Boston College with extensive study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Neill Library first floor will remain open for use until 2:00 am.
cards.source_title: Opening Hours - Boston College Libraries
cards.access_notes: BC ID required for access after 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Loop the Reservoir
cards.subtitle: Off-Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Take a 1.5-mile walk or run around the perimeter path. It is a favorite local spot for students to get fresh air just off campus.
cards.short_summary: A scenic reservoir adjacent to campus featuring a popular 1.56-mile perimeter running path.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus is right next to the reservoir which has a dirt path around the perimeter. Measures 1.56 miles.
cards.source_title: Good running routes/gym : r/bostoncollege
cards.access_notes: Public access daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Explore the McMullen
cards.subtitle: Brighton Campus Culture
cards.notes: Visit the university's art museum on the Brighton Campus to see rotating exhibitions. Admission is always free for students.
cards.short_summary: The university's art museum featuring world-class exhibitions and permanent collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The McMullen Museum charges no admission and is open Saturday-Sunday, 12:00–5:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Visit – McMullen Museum of Art - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open weekends from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Attend FanFest
cards.subtitle: Game Day Atmosphere
cards.notes: Experience the pre-game energy at FanFest with music and performances by the BC Marching Band before heading to the stadium.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for pre-game festivities and student spirit on football game days.
cards.evidence_claim: FanFest begins 4 hours before kickoff outside the Margot Connell Recreation Center, with music and performances.
cards.source_title: Your Visits to BC - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; specific areas like the Mods are restricted to residents and 21+ on game days.

cards.title: Cheer at Alumni Stadium
cards.subtitle: Home of the Eagles
cards.notes: Don your Superfan shirt and join the student section to cheer on the Eagles football team in this 44,500-seat stadium.
cards.short_summary: The primary football stadium on campus and home to the Boston College Eagles.
cards.evidence_claim: With a capacity of 44,500 maroon and gold clad fans, Alumni Stadium is the home of the Eagles.
cards.source_title: Football A-Z Guide - Boston College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Ticket required for entry; student tickets available through the athletics portal.

cards.title: Dinner at Lower Live
cards.subtitle: Lower Campus Dining
cards.notes: Grab dinner at 'Lower,' the main dining hall for students living on the lower part of campus, featuring a variety of hot meal stations.
cards.short_summary: A major dining facility on Lower Campus known as 'Lower Live.'
cards.evidence_claim: Experience the vibrant atmosphere of Lower Live in Corcoran Commons, open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.source_title: Lower Live - Dining Services - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check the BC Dining app for real-time station availability.

cards.title: Catch a Performance
cards.subtitle: Campus Arts Hub
cards.notes: Check the weekend schedule for student dance showcases or theater productions in this central arts venue.
cards.short_summary: The primary venue for theater, dance, and musical performances at Boston College.
cards.evidence_claim: Robsham Theater Arts Center hosts various events including the Rookie Showcase and theater productions.
cards.source_title: Robsham Theater Arts Center - Boston College Events
cards.access_notes: Box office hours vary; many student performances require advance ticket purchase.

cards.title: Photo at Gasson Hall
cards.subtitle: Iconic Gothic Landmark
cards.notes: End your weekend by taking a photo in front of the iconic Gasson Tower, the most recognizable building on the Heights.
cards.short_summary: The centerpiece of Boston College's Collegiate Gothic architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: Gasson Hall is noted for its Collegiate Gothic architecture and is a permanent fixture of the campus skyline.
cards.source_title: Visit - Boston College
cards.access_notes: Exterior accessible 24/7; interior access typically limited to academic hours.
